idle: Four sequential frames of the same seated dog facing slightly toward the viewer: eyes open, gentle blink, eyes open again, small relaxed tail movement. All four paws and the entire tail anatomically plausible; seated head and shoulders unchanged, no body growth.
sit: Four sequential frames of the same dog settling into a calm seated rest: seated attentive, small head tilt, head returns upright, calm eyes. Same seated body and head size, both front paws planted, rear legs naturally visible, tail resting at the side.
walk: Four sequential frames of a slow walking cycle in exact side profile moving toward screen RIGHT: nose points right and tail extends left in every frame. Show alternating front and rear paw contact with plausible canine anatomy, exactly four legs. At least one paw touches the same ground baseline in every frame. Head size unchanged, no forward displacement within its cell.
run: Four sequential frames of a cheerful gentle running cycle in exact side profile moving toward screen RIGHT: nose points right and tail extends left. Four anatomically correct legs in varied stride phases, clear silhouettes, no extra paws, no body growth, no jumping or vertical displacement, at least one paw at ground baseline in each frame. Head size unchanged.
sleep: Four sequential frames of the same adult dog sleeping on its belly curled comfortably with its chin resting on its front paws, eyes closed, rear legs naturally tucked and occluded, fluffy tail alongside. Very subtle breathing, not four different dogs. Head size must match the seated dog; body becomes low and long because of the pose, never shrunk to a miniature dog.
drag: Four sequential frames of the same dog gently suspended upright, front legs hanging downward with small movement, two anatomically plausible hind legs slightly tucked, four limbs total, fluffy tail at the side. No hand, harness, string, clothing or props. Calm expression and same head size as seated reference. No extra paws, no floating detached paws; dog stays centered at identical scale.
fall: Four sequential frames of the same dog preparing to land while suspended upright, four anatomically correct legs slightly spread and flexed, paws visible and connected, tail balancing gently. No jumping positions within the canvas, program supplies all vertical movement. Same head and body size as other poses. No props, motion lines, shadows or extra limbs.
happy: Four sequential frames of the same seated dog happily responding: warm attentive smile, gentle tail wag left, tail wag right, warm relaxed smile. Both front paws planted, same head and body size. Mouth only slightly opens, no human gesture and no large tongue. Four anatomically correct limbs, one tail, no heart symbols or props.
